title: juicy sweet german borlotti beans gratin
description: a sweet and gooey german dish featuring borlotti beans, made with satvik-friendly ingredients and cooked to perfection on a cedar plank.
instructions: soak the borlotti beans overnight, then drain and set aside
slice the onion and cook in a pan with a little oil until softened
add the garlic and cook for a further 2 minutes
in a separate pan, toast the double-rise bread until golden brown
in a bowl, mash the cooked onion mixture with the honey and butter until well combined
add the toasted bread to the bowl and mix until a crumbly mixture forms
add the soaked borlotti beans to the bowl and stir to combine
transfer the mixture to a cedar plank and top with grated nutmeg
bake in the oven for 25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown
garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot
